exceptions.title: uses the rendered portal ID for the aria-owns relationship
exceptions.reason: The case renders `FloatingFocusManager`, which Vase UI does not have. The pull request that adds `FloatingFocusManager.tsx` ports the case.

exceptions.title: $name without canceling a view transition
exceptions.reason: The cases use `React.ViewTransition` to test that the retry of the container check does not cancel a view transition. Vue has no such retry.

exceptions.title: does not cancel a view transition that reveals a hidden pending portal
exceptions.reason: The case uses `React.ViewTransition` and `React.Activity` to test that the retry of the container check does not cancel a view transition. Vue has no such retry.

exceptions.title: mounts children once in a connected container when a later update replaces its ref
exceptions.reason: The Vue portal gets its container in the flush after the mount. When updates in that flush replace the container, the children mount in the first container. That container is out of the document when their `onMounted` hooks run. Vue then moves the children to the new container. The case "mounts the children once, and moves them when updates in the flush of the mount replace the container" tests this.
